import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    a,b,c,d,e,g = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5]
    return a*P*(1-P/b)*(P-c) - d*P**2/(1+e*P) + g*P

    cc,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(B,dP_dt,rcond=None); return np.mean((dP_dt-B@cc)**2)/np.var(dP_dt),cc
